episodes.synopsis: After nearly depleting the planet's spiritual energy by going back in time, Wang Ling dreams of only one thing: to be left alone. Unfortunately, fate seems to have other plans for him.
episodes.title: Wang Ling Wants To Lead A Quiet Life

episodes.synopsis: Sent to Earth to annihilate the human race and conquer the planet, Chienpaud is far from having achieved his goals. His master decides to come and ask him to account.
episodes.title: A Home Visit By The Demon Master

episodes.synopsis: Ten years ago, the famous assassin nicknamed "Vagabond Charmer" disappeared without a trace. Some rumors claim that he is hiding near the 60th school of Songhai…
episodes.title: The Idle Beauty

episodes.synopsis: After taking a class on spirit swords at school, Wang Ling and his friends decide to go and have their respective weapons serviced.
episodes.title: How To Forge A Spiritual Sword

episodes.synopsis: Four great legends circulate in the 60th school. Is there any truth behind the rumors?
episodes.title: The Four Bizarre Tales of Faction 60

episodes.synopsis: Seduced by a streamer, Chen Chao becomes a little too obsessive. His worried friends try to get him back in touch with reality.
episodes.title: The Internet Is Not A Lawless Paradise

episodes.synopsis: The wealthy Sun family is going through a difficult phase. Fortunately, they are not the type to give up.
episodes.title: The Foolish Old Man's Spirit in the Sun Family

episodes.synopsis: Several students from the 60th school decide to enter the Songhai Artistic Fencing Competition to prove that spiritual swords are more than weapons.
episodes.title: A Sword Dance of the Five Elements

episodes.synopsis: After the contest misadventure, the whole planet fell madly in love with Sun Rong. If he doesn't quickly find a way to ward off the spell, things will end badly.
episodes.title: A Train to the Twinkling Stars

episodes.synopsis: The Elite class of the 60th school of Songhai visits an animation studio and discovers the harsh reality of jobs in the sector.
episodes.title: Extra: The Director Is Not Home Today

episodes.synopsis: The Demon Emperor seems to have realized that Wang Ling poses a considerable threat, while Richman is still determined to destroy Earth. The apocalypse is closer than ever.
episodes.title: The Coming

episodes.synopsis: The survival of all mankind is threatened by the invasion of demons. Will Wang Ling stand up to an empire that has already conquered countless planets?
episodes.title: The Observer Beyond Time and Space
